title: Ambiance exercise and step 16 of controlled remote viewing training

tellings.quote:
We have a thing called the ambiance
exercise.

plain: Training in controlled remote viewing, a step-by-step method for trying to perceive distant places with the mind, includes something called the ambiance exercise and a sixteenth step. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who trained remote viewers, describes these to Michels from his own experience, saying simply, "We have a thing called the ambiance exercise." How the exercise works is not spelled out in the telling, but it is part of the method he says he taught.
